[[File:TacticalDroid-TCW.png|thumb|right|200px|[[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]], a T-series tactical droid]]
'''Tactical droids''' were [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]]s designed to serve as combat consultants, boasting advanced combat-analysis software to help them determine exactly when and where to attack for the greatest effect.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Originally known as the CDE-T unit, the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] was a model of tactical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> to provide the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] with tactical leadership during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> This standard tactical droid was replaced by the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] later in the conflict, which improved upon the shortcomings of the former.<ref name="General Kalani">{{SWE|characters|general-kalani|General Kalani}}</ref>
